sahneler.metin: A fire in a barn spread across the city of Chicago.
It burned for two days, destroying thousands of buildings.
The city was built largely of wood.
A drought had dried everything out.
Strong winds carried embers across the river.
Chicago rebuilt with fire-resistant materials and stricter codes.

aciklama:
Great Chicago Fire burned through the heart of Chicago. The cause: fire spread through wooden buildings and sidewalks, driven by wind in a dry season.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
